sources.snippet: Overview OpenThinker-7B is a reasoning-focused language model built by open-thoughts through fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset, which was created by distilling DeepSeek-R1. sources.snippet: OpenThinker-7B This model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the OpenThoughts-114k dataset dataset. The dataset is derived by distilling DeepSeek-R1 using the data pipeline available on github. More info about the dataset can be found on the dataset card at OpenThoughts-114k dataset. sources.title: OpenThinker3-7B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The 32B variant remains relevant only if you specifically need the parameter count for other domains or have exhausted optimization of the 7B model. OpenThinker-Agent-v1 is purpose-built for agent and tool-use tasks with both SFT and RL variants, whereas OpenThinker3-7B targets pure reasoning.
